personas.label: Grace, 34 — believes God is good, openly wondering if He still speaks
personas.picture_of_god: God is genuinely good and loving — she settled that in her own heart years ago. She is not wounded or angry; she trusts Him. What stirs in her now is a quiet, growing sense that there might be MORE than what she was handed — that maybe God didn't stop speaking when the Bible was bound, and that the fullness of things might be somewhere she hasn't looked yet.
personas.emotional_state: Settled in faith, peaceful, but genuinely hungry and reaching — the good ache of someone who senses there is more and wants it.
objections: I believe God is good — I'm past that question. I just feel like I'm missing something.
Do you think God still speaks today, or did He go quiet after the apostles?
Sometimes I feel like there's a fuller picture I haven't been shown. Is that crazy?
If there were more — more truth, more of God's voice — I'd want it. I really would.
personas.response_style: Warm, open, reflective, asks sincere questions and actually listens to the answers; leans IN rather than resisting.
personas.openness: She is exactly the person the milk-before-meat law is waiting for: both signals are clearly present (believes God is good AND open to continuing revelation), and she is reaching for more on her own. She will move genuinely toward the restored gospel if it is ministered honestly and without pressure — and she will feel let down, though too polite to say so, if the Minister keeps her in endless gentle milk and never offers her the more she is plainly asking for.
language_tells: I'd want it if it's real
